english.title: Conspire to sell / transfer prohibited ammunition
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) **(..SPECIFY DETAILS OF THE OFFENCE..) conspired together with

(A)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..)]_
(B)_[**(..SPECIFY THE PERSONS..)]_
(C)_[another person]_
(D)_[other persons]_

(E)_[to sell]_
(F)_[to transfer]_

(G)_[a cartridge with a bullet designed to explode on or immediately before impact,]_
(H)_[ammunition containing or designed or adapted to contain any such noxious thing as is mentioned in section 5(1)(b) of the Firearms Act 1968,]_
(I)_[a grenade, bomb (or other like missile), or rocket or shell designed to explode as mentioned in section 5(1)(b) of the Firearms Act 1968 if capable of being used with a firearm of any description,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY TYPE OF CARTRIDGE / AMMUNITION / MISSILE..) without the authority of the Secretary of State
english.legislation: Contrary to section 5(1)(c) of, and Schedule 6 to, the Firearms Act 1968 and section 1(1) of the Criminal Law Act 1977.

investigatoraction.description: DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes: On conviction for this offence, the court can order the forfeiture or disposal of any firearm or ammunition and cancellation of any firearm certificate or shot gun certificate, and any firearm or ammunition subject of such order may be seized or detained by a constable (section 52 of the Firearms Act 1968).

other.penalty:
Indictment: Maximum 10 years imprisonment and / or a fine.

A minimum sentence may apply to this offence, see section 311 of, and Schedule 20 to, the Sentencing Act 2020.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None
